_doc: The coping hour (Halls of Torment style). abilities auto-fire from every fighter and level 1-7; traits stack (max); items drop from elites (pick 1 of 3, four slots) and one can be carried out through the Lost & Found well into later hours. Numbers are per level unless noted.

abilities.name: INVOICE TOSS
abilities.blurb: Throws a spinning invoice at the nearest thug. Paper cuts are still cuts.

abilities.name: STAPLER SPRAY
abilities.blurb: A cone of staples where you face. Office supplies, weaponised.

abilities.name: COFFEE SPILL
abilities.blurb: Leaves a scalding puddle that burns whoever stands in it. Contents hot.

abilities.name: ORBITING CLIPBOARDS
abilities.blurb: Clipboards circle you and slap anything they pass. Paperwork orbits you now.

abilities.name: LATE FEE LIGHTNING
abilities.blurb: Lightning jumps between thugs. Every jump adds interest.

abilities.name: DAD JOKE SHOCKWAVE
abilities.blurb: A ground-shaking pun knocks everyone around you flat. Groaning is damage.

abilities.name: HOLD MUSIC
abilities.blurb: A wave of hold music pierces the whole line. Your call is important to us.

abilities.name: FRIDGE MAGNET MINES
abilities.blurb: Drops magnets that blow up when a thug steps close. The drawings survive.

abilities.name: FAMILY PHOTO FLASH
abilities.blurb: Say cheese: a flash that stuns and singes the room.

abilities.name: IV DRIP AURA
abilities.blurb: A cold drip aura that hurts everything close, all the time. Hydration with intent.

abilities.name: SHOPPING CART
abilities.blurb: A runaway cart ploughs through the whole street. No receipt.

abilities.name: GARBAGE BAG
abilities.blurb: A bag of hot garbage swung round on a rope. Wide, slow, smelly.

abilities.name: HYDRANT
abilities.blurb: A burst of water from the kerb shoves every thug away from you.

abilities.name: MAIL BOMB
abilities.blurb: A parcel lobbed into the thickest crowd. Return to sender.

abilities.name: SPRINKLER
abilities.blurb: Staples in a ring, every direction at once. Lawn of pain.

abilities.name: TAX AUDIT
abilities.blurb: One bolt that jumps through half the street. Everyone owes.

abilities.name: GRAVY SPILL
abilities.blurb: Hot gravy pools under the biggest crowd and slows them down.

abilities.name: BADGE BOOMERANG
abilities.blurb: Your name badge flies out and comes back, through everyone both ways. HELLO, MY NAME IS: PAIN.

abilities.name: SHREDDER BLADE
abilities.blurb: A shredder blade bounces round the screen for four seconds. Confidential. Also you.

abilities.name: FAX BEAM
abilities.blurb: A screeching fax beam burns a straight line where you face. Every thug on it gets the memo.

abilities.name: RUBBER STAMP
abilities.blurb: A giant DENIED stamp slams down on a thug and everyone around him. Application rejected.

abilities.name: NAIL DRIVER
abilities.blurb: MANUAL: hold SHOOT with empty hands for a stream of nails where you face. Aim by facing.

abilities.name: PAPERWEIGHT
abilities.blurb: MANUAL: tap SHOOT with empty hands to lob a glass paperweight that shatters on the crowd.

traits.name: OVERCOMMIT
traits.blurb: +1 projectile on every ability that throws things.

traits.name: STRESS EATING
traits.blurb: +12 max health per stack, healed now.

traits.name: DENIAL
traits.blurb: Regenerate 0.6 health a second per stack.

traits.name: LUCKY BREAK
traits.blurb: +6% chance for abilities to crit for double.

traits.name: CURSE
traits.blurb: +10% more thugs, +15% experience and +10% tokens per stack.

traits.name: THORNS
traits.blurb: Thugs that hit you take 6 damage back per stack.

traits.name: LUCK
traits.blurb: +4% crit per stack, and chests roll rarer items.

traits.name: VAMPIRE
traits.blurb: Every 25 kills heal 3 HP per stack.

items.name: LUCKY COIN
items.blurb: +10% crit chance. Heads you win, tails they lose teeth.

items.name: GYM MEMBERSHIP
items.blurb: +25 max health. You went once. It counts.

items.name: PARKING TICKET
items.blurb: Ability hits slow thugs by 30% for a second.

items.name: GROUP HUG AMULET
items.blurb: Every level up heals 20% of max health.

items.name: BOTTOMLESS THERMOS
items.blurb: -15% cooldowns. The coffee never ends. Neither does the shift.

items.name: MAGNET GLOVE
items.blurb: Gems fly in from twice as far.

items.name: WORLD'S BEST DAD MUG
items.blurb: Kills heal 1 health. The mug was a gift. From himself.

items.name: ENDLESS RECEIPT
items.blurb: Abilities fire twice as often for 5s after every level up. Itemised fury.

evolutions.name: AUDIT STORM
evolutions.blurb: Invoices in every direction, through everyone.

evolutions.name: NAIL GUN NIGHTMARE
evolutions.blurb: Twice the staples, twice as fast.

evolutions.name: BOTTOMLESS POT
evolutions.blurb: Huge burning puddles that never cool.

evolutions.name: BOARD MEETING
evolutions.blurb: A ring of clipboards, wider and harder.

evolutions.name: ON HOLD FOREVER
evolutions.blurb: A wall of notes in both directions.

evolutions.name: PAPARAZZI
evolutions.blurb: Flash after flash; they never see again.

evolutions.name: LEAKY ROOF
evolutions.blurb: A wide aura that heals you as it hurts.

evolutions.name: BLACK FRIDAY STAMPEDE
evolutions.blurb: Three carts at once, both ways.

evolutions.name: IRS
evolutions.blurb: Every thug on screen gets audited.

evolutions.name: THANKSGIVING
evolutions.blurb: Gravy everywhere; it heals the family.

ultimates.name: COPAY CRASH
ultimates.blurb: Everything on screen takes a heavy hit and is shoved back.

ultimates.name: PANIC ROOM
ultimates.blurb: Six seconds in a dome: you can't be touched and anything inside burns.

ultimates.name: BLACK FRIDAY
ultimates.blurb: Every thug on screen takes damage and drops experience and coins.
